create_nested_dictionary_dataset: create a NestedDictionaryDataset from a nested dict of datasets with matching lengths
flatten_nested_dict: use _flatten to convert a nested dictionary into a flat OrderedDict with dot-separated keys
unflatten_dict: use _unflatten to restore a flat OrderedDict back into a nested dictionary structure
collate_samples: call collater on a NestedDictionaryDataset to merge a list of samples into a mini-batch
prefetch_dataset_indices: call prefetch on a NestedDictionaryDataset to preload data for the given sample indices
